title: Memoirs of a Geisha
author: Arthur Golden
summary: A poor fisherman's daughter is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto in the 1930s. She trains in the arts and politics of the flower and willow world, hoping for the favour of one man.
readIf: you like lush, detailed historical fiction with a first-person voice and a slow, longing love story.
skipIf: you want an authentically Japanese viewpoint; it is a Western author's imagined account, which some readers and a legal case challenged.

pairings.reason: Another saga about a woman from a poor background in Japan, told with a more realistic, grounded eye.
Women's life stories shaped by tradition and sacrifice, in a shorter and more varied form.
A short, quiet novel about a girl of low status drawn into a world of art and unspoken desire.
